label: Malibu

zip_outside.90265: The Santa Monica Mountains outside the city

zip_caveats: All of the City of Malibu is in ZIP 90265, but most of that ZIP's land is outside city limits: the Santa Monica Mountains above the city and part of Topanga. People there live in unincorporated Los Angeles County, so they don't vote for Malibu City Council. That's why the guide asks which side you live on. Pepperdine University (ZIP 90263) is outside the city too. Everyone in the city votes in the same races. All of Malibu is in U.S. House District 32 (the 2025 map), State Senate District 24 and Assembly District 42. Outside the city, a small part of 90265 is in House District 26 and Senate District 21 instead, and District 21 has no race this year. Malibu also shares two school boards with Santa Monica: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified and Santa Monica College. Both are elected by voters in both cities. Malibu has no city measure this year, and neither school district has one. Santa Monica's school parcel tax, Measure ES, is a City of Santa Monica measure, so Malibu voters don't see it. Malibu is in Division IV of the West Basin Municipal Water District, but there's no race for it: only the sitting director filed, so that election was canceled. Your sample ballot at isb.lavote.gov shows your exact ballot.

situations.short: Get a replacement at any LA County vote center or just vote there.
situations.answer: The last day to ask for a ballot by mail was October 27. You can still go to any LA County vote center and ask for a replacement or vote there in person. Questions? Call (800) 815-2666, press 2, then 3.
steps: Use the county's locator to find a vote center near you.
